title: UI Snapshotflow: canonicalization, density-aware crops, and privacy masks for quickstart visuals
creator: Marco Alvarez
description: Problem statement: our quickstart docs and in-product banners use a mix of hand-edited screenshots that vary in scale, visible user data, and untranslated copy. This causes inconsistent brand presentation, requires heavy manual labor for each locale, and creates privacy risk when real identifiers leak into images. Goal: design a deterministic snapshot pipeline ("Snapshotflow") that produces brand-consistent UI visuals for quickstarts and docs. The pipeline should: 1) canonicalize UI state (browser chrome, responsive breakpoints), 2) apply density-aware cropping and alignment rules so components are framed consistently across screen sizes, 3) enforce pixel-safe redaction masks for any PII or customer-specific tokens, 4) apply locale-safe overlays (translated chrome, date/number formats) without re-rendering product state, and 5) output multiple asset variants (hero, thumbnail, narrow) with naming metadata for automation. The design deliverables will include heuristics for crop focus, mask shapes and padding, a minimal visual token set (type scale, corner radii, brand color overlays), and an asset QA checklist used by content and engineering pipelines.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec describing canonical viewport presets (mobile/tablet/desktop) and component-safe margins
Crop heuristics doc with edge-case rules for tables, code blocks, and chat transcript views
Redaction mask guidelines covering email, API keys, tokens, avatars; mask shapes, blur vs block rules, and GDPR-safe formatting
Localization overlay recipe that accepts a translation keyfile and aligns translated chrome without touching app state
Design handoff package (Figma + JSON token file) and sample exported assets for 3 locales (en-US, fr-FR, ja-JP)
QA checklist that can be integrated into the visual CI step and run by content ops
tasks: Workshop with Product + Engineering to align on pipeline inputs/outputs and security constraints
Define canonical view presets and a small set of 'anchor components' to guide crop focus
Draft redaction mask patterns and run 10 sample screenshots through prototypes to validate no visible PII
Create localization overlay spec: token placement rules, fallback rules for RTL and long strings
Produce Figma library with tokenized overlays and export automation notes (naming, metadata)
Coord with ENG to define API contract for snapshot requests and return values (state ID, locale, cropKind)
Author Visual QA checklist and integrate with docs CI to auto-compare baseline assets
Pilot rollout: generate assets for Quickstart A, Docs Getting Started, and Console Welcome banner
design_assets: Example exports: hero_en-US.png, thumb_fr-FR.png, banner_ja-JP.png (stored in drive sample-exports folder)
notes: Avoid manual pixel-tweaks for each locale; create overlay-first approach where translations are applied as separate layers.
For chat transcripts, prefer line-preserving crops and masks that keep bubble boundaries intact to avoid visual artifacts.
Where API tokens appear, replace with fixed-length token placeholders (e.g., '••••-xxxx') rather than black boxes to preserve affordance.
Consider two redaction modes: reversible (blur with preserved length metadata) for internal review, irreversible (solid mask) for public assets.
Edge case: long code snippets — crop to the first and last visible lines and add a gradient fade to hint more content; avoid cropping mid-URL.
Coordinate with ENG-4912 (snapshot service) to include a 'safety metadata' field in exported asset JSON so content ops can audit masks programmatically.
updates: 2025-02-11: Kickoff workshop held with Product and ENG. Agreed canonical presets: 360x800 (mobile), 1024x768 (tablet), 1440x900 (desktop). Action: ENG to prototype snapshot API endpoint returning raw PNG + DOM metadata.
2025-02-13: Prototype mask rules v0 created. Initial tests show avatar crops sometimes cut corners — updated corner padding rule to 12px for avatar-containing cards.
2025-02-15: Localization overlay draft reviewed; content ops requested a safe-fallback string shortening rule. Design to propose ellipsization policy and scaled type tokens.
2025-02-18: Figma token library delivered to ENG for basic export automation. Next: run pilot on three quickstarts and produce QA diff images. Assigned QA step to Noah Park.
